a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan needs two generator rounds before anyone takes. That gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. I don't think that plan can work, so I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you have a better idea, tell me. If we both take, the split is random.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said, I'm taking 4 now, which breaks our agreement. I'm sorry. If no storm comes, I'll operate the generator with you every round so you can reach 4, and I won't take anything more.
